verses.text: Abimelech di pikin of Jerubbaal go Shechem to im mama brothers, and speak with dem, and with all di family of di house of im mama papa, talk,

“Please speak for di ears of all di men of Shechem, ‘Wetin better for una, say all di pikin man dem of Jerubbaal, wey be 70 persons, rule over una, or say one man rule over una?’ Remember too say I na una bone and una flesh.”
Im mama brothers speak about am for di ears of all di men of Shechem all dis words, and dem heart lean to follow Abimelech, because dem talk say, “E na our brother.”
Dem give am 70 pieces of silver out of di house of Baal-Berith, and with am Abimelech hire empty and reckless men, wey follow am.
E go im papa house for Ophrah, and kill im brothers di pikin man dem of Jerubbaal, wey be 70 persons, on one stone. But Jotham, di youngest pikin man of Jerubbaal, remain, because e hide imself.
All di men of Shechem gather demselves together, with all di house of Millo, and dem go make Abimelech king, by di oak of di pillar wey dey Shechem.
When dem tell Jotham, e go stand for di top of Mount Gerizim, lift up im voice, cry out, and talk to dem, “Listen to me, una men of Shechem, so that God go listen to una.
Di trees go out one time to anoint king over dem. Dem talk to di olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’
But di olive tree talk to dem, ‘I go leave my fatness, wey dem dey use honour God and man, to go wave over di trees?’
Di trees talk to di fig tree, ‘Come, reign over us.’
But di fig tree talk to dem, ‘I go leave my sweetness and my good fruit, to go wave over di trees?’
Di trees talk to di vine, ‘Come, reign over us.’
Di vine talk to dem, ‘I go leave my new wine, wey dey make God and man happy, to go wave over di trees?’
Den all di trees talk to di bramble, ‘Come, reign over us.’
Di bramble talk to di trees, ‘If na truth una anoint me king over una, den come take refuge for my shade. If no be so, make fire come out of di bramble, and eat up di cedars of Lebanon.’
Now so, if una don do truth and uprightness, say una don make Abimelech king, and if una don treat Jerubbaal and im house well, and don do to am according to wetin im hands deserve,
because my papa fight for una, risk im life, and deliver una out of di hand of Midian,

and una don rise up against my papa house dis day, and kill im pikin man dem, 70 persons, on one stone, and make Abimelech, di pikin man of im woman servant, king over di men of Shechem, because e na una brother,
if una don do truth and uprightness with Jerubbaal and im house dis day, den rejoice for Abimelech, and make e rejoice for una too.
But if no be so, make fire come out from Abimelech, and eat up di men of Shechem and di house of Millo. Make fire come out from di men of Shechem and from di house of Millo, and eat up Abimelech.”
Jotham run, flee, and go Beer, and dwell dere, because e fear Abimelech im brother.
Abimelech rule Israel as prince for three years.
Den God send one evil spirit between Abimelech and di men of Shechem, and di men of Shechem deal treacherously with Abimelech,

so that di violence wey dem do to di 70 pikin man dem of Jerubbaal go come, and dem blood go land on Abimelech dem brother, wey kill dem, and on di men of Shechem, wey strengthen im hands to kill im brothers.
Di men of Shechem set ambush for am for di tops of di mountains, and dem rob all wey pass dat way near dem. Dem tell Abimelech.
Gaal di pikin of Ebed come with im brothers, pass over to Shechem, and di men of Shechem put dem trust for am.
Dem go out enter di field, gather dem vineyards, tread di grapes, hold festival, go enter di house of dem god, eat and drink, and curse Abimelech.

Gaal di pikin of Ebed talk say, “Who be Abimelech, and who be Shechem, say we go serve am? No be di pikin of Jerubbaal be dat? And Zebul im officer? Serve di men of Hamor di papa of Shechem. But why we go serve am?
If only dis people dey under my hand! Den I go remove Abimelech. I go talk to Abimelech say, ‘Increase your army, and come out.’”
When Zebul di ruler of di city hear di words of Gaal di pikin of Ebed, im anger burn.
E send messengers to Abimelech with trick, talk say, “Look, Gaal di pikin of Ebed and im brothers don come to Shechem, and look, dem dey turn di city against you.
So now, go up for night, you and di people wey dey with you, and hide wait for di field.
E go be say for morning, as soon as di sun rise, you go rise early, and rush on di city. Look, when e and di people wey dey with am come out against you, den you go do to dem as you see chance.”
Abimelech rise up for night, with all di people wey dey with am, and dem hide wait against Shechem for four companies.
Gaal di pikin of Ebed go out, stand for di entrance of di gate of di city. Abimelech rise up, with di people wey dey with am, from di ambush.
When Gaal see di people, e talk to Zebul, “Look, people dey come down from di tops of di mountains.” Zebul talk to am, “You see di shadow of di mountains like say dem na men.”
Gaal speak again, talk say, “Look, people dey come down by di middle of di land, and one company dey come by di way of di Diviners Oak.”
Den Zebul talk to am, “Wia your mouth dey now, wey you talk say, ‘Who be Abimelech, say we go serve am?’ Dis no be di people wey you don despise? Go out now, I pray, and fight dem.”
Gaal go out before di men of Shechem, and fight Abimelech.
Abimelech chase am, and e run before am, and plenty fall wounded, reach di entrance of di gate.
Abimelech dey live for Arumah, and Zebul drive out Gaal and im brothers, so dem no go dwell for Shechem.
E happen di next day say di people go out enter di field, and dem tell Abimelech.
E take di people, divide dem into three companies, and hide wait for di field. E look, and see say di people dey come out of di city, so e rise up against dem, and strike dem.
Abimelech, with di companies wey dey with am, rush forward, and stand for di entrance of di gate of di city. Di two companies rush on all wey dey for di field, and strike dem.
Abimelech fight against di city all dat day. E take di city, kill di people wey dey inside am, break down di city, and scatter salt for am.
When all di men of di tower of Shechem hear am, dem enter di stronghold of di house of Elberith.
Dem tell Abimelech say all di men of di tower of Shechem don gather together.

Abimelech go up to Mount Zalmon, e and all di people wey dey with am. Abimelech take axe for im hand, cut down one branch from di trees, lift am up, put am for im shoulder, and talk to di people wey dey with am, “Wetin una see me do, hurry, do am as I do.”

All di people cut down every man im branch too, and follow Abimelech, put dem for di stronghold, and set di stronghold on fire over dem. So all di people of di tower of Shechem die too, about one thousand men and women.
Den Abimelech go Thebez, camp against Thebez, and take am.
But one strong tower dey inside di city, and all di men and women run enter dere, all of di city, and dem shut demselves inside, and go up to di roof of di tower.
Abimelech come to di tower, fight against am, and come near di door of di tower to burn am with fire.
One woman throw upper millstone on Abimelech head, and break im skull.

Den e call quick to di young man wey carry im armour, and talk to am, “Draw your sword, and kill me, so that people no go talk about me say, ‘One woman kill am.’” Im young man push sword through am, and e die.
When di men of Israel see say Abimelech don die, dem go, every man to im place.
So God pay back di wickedness of Abimelech, wey e do to im papa, as e kill im 70 brothers.
God pay back all di wickedness of di men of Shechem on dem heads too, and di curse of Jotham di pikin of Jerubbaal come on dem.
After Abimelech, Tola di pikin of Puah, di pikin of Dodo, one man of Issachar, rise up to save Israel. E dey live for Shamir for di hill country of Ephraim.
E judge Israel for 23 years, and die, and dem bury am for Shamir.
After am Jair di Gileadite rise up, and e judge Israel for 22 years.
E get 30 pikin man dem wey dey ride 30 donkey colts, and dem get 30 cities, wey dem dey call Havvoth Jair till dis day, wey dey di land of Gilead.
Jair die, and dem bury am for Kamon.

Di pikin dem of Israel do wetin dey evil for di eyes of di Lord again, and serve di Baals, di Ashtaroth, di gods of Syria, di gods of Sidon, di gods of Moab, di gods of di pikin dem of Ammon and di gods of di Philistines. Dem leave di Lord, and no serve am.
Di anger of di Lord burn against Israel, and e sell dem into di hands of di Philistines and into di hands of di pikin dem of Ammon.
Dem trouble and oppress di pikin dem of Israel dat year. For 18 years dem oppress all di pikin dem of Israel wey dey di other side of di Jordan, for di land of di Amorites, wey dey Gilead.
Di pikin dem of Ammon pass over di Jordan to fight against Judah too, and against Benjamin and against di house of Ephraim, so tay Israel dey in great distress.
Di pikin dem of Israel cry to di Lord, talk say, “We don sin against you, because we don leave our God, and serve di Baals.”
Di Lord talk to di pikin dem of Israel, “I no save una from di Egyptians, from di Amorites, from di pikin dem of Ammon and from di Philistines?
Di Sidonians too, di Amalekites and di Maonites oppress una, and una cry to me, and I save una out of dem hand.
But una don leave me, and serve other gods. So I no go save una again.
Go cry to di gods wey una choose. Make dem save una for di time of una distress.”
Di pikin dem of Israel talk to di Lord, “We don sin. Do to us anything wey good for your eyes, only deliver us, please, dis day.”
Dem put away di foreign gods from among dem, and serve di Lord. Im soul sorry for di misery of Israel.
Den di pikin dem of Ammon gather together, and camp for Gilead. Di pikin dem of Israel gather demselves together, and camp for Mizpah.
Di people, di princes of Gilead, talk to each other, “Who be di man wey go begin fight against di pikin dem of Ammon? E go be head over all di people wey dey live for Gilead.”
Now Jephthah di Gileadite na mighty man of valour, and e na pikin man of one prostitute. Gilead born Jephthah.
Gilead wife born pikin man dem for am. When im wife pikin man dem grow, dem drive Jephthah out, and talk to am, “You no go inherit for our papa house, because you na pikin man of another woman.”
Den Jephthah run from im brothers, and dey live for di land of Tob. Empty men gather to Jephthah, and dem go out with am.
E happen say after some time, di pikin dem of Ammon make war against Israel.
E happen say, when di pikin dem of Ammon make war against Israel, di elders of Gilead go bring Jephthah from di land of Tob.
Dem talk to Jephthah, “Come, and be our chief, so that we fit fight di pikin dem of Ammon.”
Jephthah talk to di elders of Gilead, “Una no hate me, and drive me out of my papa house? Why una come to me now wey una dey in trouble?”
Di elders of Gilead talk to Jephthah, “Na why we don turn to you now, so that you go go with us, fight di pikin dem of Ammon, and be our head over all di people wey dey live for Gilead.”
Jephthah talk to di elders of Gilead, “If una bring me back home to fight di pikin dem of Ammon, and di Lord deliver dem before me, I go be una head?”
Di elders of Gilead talk to Jephthah, “Di Lord go be witness between us. Surely we go do according to your word.”
Den Jephthah go with di elders of Gilead, and di people make am head and chief over dem. Jephthah speak all im words before di Lord for Mizpah.
Jephthah send messengers to di king of di pikin dem of Ammon, talk say, “Wetin you get to do with me, say you don come to me to fight against my land?”

Di king of di pikin dem of Ammon answer di messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel take my land, when e come up out of Egypt, from di Arnon reach di Jabbok, and di Jordan. So now return dem lands again in peace.”
Jephthah send messengers again to di king of di pikin dem of Ammon,
and talk to am, “Dis na wetin Jephthah talk: ‘Israel no take di land of Moab, nor di land of di pikin dem of Ammon.
But when dem come up from Egypt, Israel waka through di wilderness reach di Red Sea, and come to Kadesh,

den Israel send messengers to di king of Edom, talk say, “Please make I pass through your land,” but di king of Edom no listen. Dem send to di king of Moab too, but e refuse. So Israel stay for Kadesh.

Den dem waka through di wilderness, go round di land of Edom and di land of Moab, come by di east side of di land of Moab, and camp for di other side of di Arnon. But dem no enter di border of Moab, because di Arnon na di border of Moab.
Israel send messengers to Sihon king of di Amorites, di king of Heshbon, and Israel talk to am, “Please make we pass through your land to my place.”
But Sihon no trust Israel to pass through im border. Sihon gather all im people together, camp for Jahaz, and fight against Israel.
Di Lord, di God of Israel, deliver Sihon and all im people into di hand of Israel, and dem strike dem. So Israel possess all di land of di Amorites, di people wey dey live for dat country.
Dem possess all di border of di Amorites, from di Arnon reach di Jabbok, and from di wilderness reach di Jordan.
So now di Lord, di God of Israel, don drive out di Amorites from before im people Israel, and you wan possess dem?
You no go possess wetin Chemosh your god give you to possess? So anybody wey di Lord our God drive out from before us, dem we go possess.
Now you better pass Balak di pikin of Zippor, king of Moab? E ever quarrel with Israel, or e ever fight dem?
While Israel dey live for Heshbon and im towns, for Aroer and im towns, and for all di cities wey dey beside di Arnon, for 300 years, why you no take dem back for dat time?
So I no sin against you, but you dey do me wrong to make war against me. Make di Lord di Judge judge dis day between di pikin dem of Israel and di pikin dem of Ammon.’”
But di king of di pikin dem of Ammon no listen to di words of Jephthah wey e send am.
Den Spirit of di Lord come on Jephthah, and e pass over Gilead and Manasseh, pass over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead e pass over go di pikin dem of Ammon.
Jephthah make vow to di Lord, and talk say, “If you go deliver di pikin dem of Ammon into my hand,
den e go be say anything wey come out of di doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from di pikin dem of Ammon, e go belong to di Lord, and I go offer am up as burnt offering.”
So Jephthah pass over go di pikin dem of Ammon to fight dem, and di Lord deliver dem into im hand.
E strike dem from Aroer till you reach Minnith, even 20 cities, and reach Abel Cheramim, with very great slaughter. So di pikin dem of Ammon come under di pikin dem of Israel.
Jephthah come to Mizpah, to im house, and look, im pikin woman come out to meet am with tambourines and dances. E na im only pikin. Apart from am, e no get pikin man or pikin woman.

E happen say, when e see am, e tear im clothes, and talk say, “Woe, my pikin woman! You don bring me very low, and you na one of dem wey dey trouble me, because I don open my mouth to di Lord, and I no fit go back.”

E talk to am, “My papa, you don open your mouth to di Lord. Do to me according to wetin come out of your mouth, because di Lord don take revenge for you on your enemies, even on di pikin dem of Ammon.”
E talk to im papa, “Make dis thing happen for me: leave me alone for two months, so that I go go wander for di mountains, and cry for my virginity, I and my friends.”
E talk say, “Go.” E send am away for two months. E go, e and im friends, and mourn im virginity for di mountains.
E happen say for di end of two months, e return to im papa, wey do to am according to im vow wey e vow. E never sleep with man. E become custom for Israel,
say di pikin woman dem of Israel dey go every year to celebrate di pikin woman of Jephthah di Gileadite for four days for one year.
Di men of Ephraim gather together, and pass go north. Dem talk to Jephthah, “Why you pass over to fight di pikin dem of Ammon, and no call us to go with you? We go burn your house with fire on you.”
Jephthah talk to dem, “I and my people dey for great quarrel with di pikin dem of Ammon. When I call una, una no save me out of dem hand.
When I see say una no save me, I put my life for my hand, and pass over against di pikin dem of Ammon, and di Lord deliver dem into my hand. Why den una come up to me dis day, to fight against me?”

Den Jephthah gather together all di men of Gilead, and fight Ephraim. Di men of Gilead strike Ephraim, because dem talk say, “Una na runaways of Ephraim, una Gileadites, for di middle of Ephraim and for di middle of Manasseh.”

Di Gileadites take di fords of di Jordan against di Ephraimites. E happen say, when any of di runaways of Ephraim talk say, “Make I pass over,” di men of Gilead talk to am, “You na Ephraimite?” If e talk say, “No,”
den dem talk to am, “Now talk ‘Shibboleth,’” and e talk “Sibboleth,” because e no fit pronounce am well. Den dem catch am, and kill am for di fords of di Jordan. For dat time 42,000 of Ephraim fall.
Jephthah judge Israel for six years. Den Jephthah di Gileadite die, and dem bury am for di cities of Gilead.
After am Ibzan of Bethlehem judge Israel.
E get 30 pikin man dem, and 30 pikin woman dem wey e send go outside, and 30 pikin woman dem wey e bring from outside for im pikin man dem. E judge Israel for seven years.
Ibzan die, and dem bury am for Bethlehem.
After am Elon di Zebulunite judge Israel, and e judge Israel for ten years.
Elon di Zebulunite die, and dem bury am for Aijalon for di land of Zebulun.
After am Abdon di pikin of Hillel di Pirathonite judge Israel.
E get 40 pikin man dem and 30 grandpikin dem, wey dey ride 70 donkey colts. E judge Israel for eight years.
Abdon di pikin of Hillel di Pirathonite die, and dem bury am for Pirathon for di land of Ephraim, for di hill country of di Amalekites.
Di pikin dem of Israel do wetin dey evil for di eyes of di Lord again, and di Lord deliver dem into di hand of di Philistines for 40 years.
One man dey for Zorah, of di family of di Danites, wey im name na Manoah. Im wife no fit born, and e no get pikin.
Di angel of di Lord appear to di woman, and talk to am, “Look now, you no fit born, and you no dey born, but you go become pregnant, and born one pikin man.
So now take care, and no drink wine or strong drink, and no eat any unclean thing,
because look, you go become pregnant, and born pikin man. Razor no go touch im head, because di pikin go be Nazirite to God from di womb. E go begin to save Israel out of di hand of di Philistines.”
Den di woman go tell im husband, talk say, “One man of God come to me, and im face be like di face of di angel of God, very fearful. I no ask am wia e come from, and e no tell me im name.

But e talk to me, ‘Look, you go become pregnant, and born pikin man. So now no drink wine or strong drink, and no eat any unclean thing, because di pikin go be Nazirite to God from di womb till di day of im death.’”
Den Manoah beg di Lord, and talk say, “Oh, Lord, please make di man of God wey you send come again to us, and teach us wetin we suppose do to di pikin wey go come.”
God listen to di voice of Manoah, and di angel of God come again to di woman as e dey sit for di field, but Manoah im husband no dey with am.
Di woman hurry, run, tell im husband, and talk to am, “Look, di man wey come to me di other day don appear to me.”
Manoah rise up, follow im wife, come to di man, and talk to am, “You na di man wey speak to di woman?” E talk say, “I be am.”
Manoah talk say, “Now make your words happen. Wetin go be di pikin way of life, and wetin go be im work?”
Di angel of di Lord talk to Manoah, “Of all wey I talk to di woman, make e take care.
E no go eat anything wey come from di vine, make e no drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing. All wey I command am, make e keep am.”
Manoah talk to di angel of di Lord, “Please make we hold you, so that we fit prepare one young goat for you.”
Di angel of di Lord talk to Manoah, “Even if you hold me, I no go eat your food. If you wan prepare burnt offering, you must offer am to di Lord.” Because Manoah no know say na di angel of di Lord.
Manoah talk to di angel of di Lord, “Wetin be your name, so that when your words happen, we go honour you?”
Di angel of di Lord talk to am, “Why you dey ask about my name, since e na wonderful?”
So Manoah take di young goat with di grain offering, and offer am on di rock to di Lord. Di angel do wonderful thing, and Manoah and im wife dey look.
Because when di flame go up toward heaven from di altar, di angel of di Lord go up inside di flame of di altar. Manoah and im wife dey look, and dem fall on dem faces to di ground.
But di angel of di Lord no appear again to Manoah or to im wife. Den Manoah know say na di angel of di Lord.
Manoah talk to im wife, “We go surely die, because we don see God.”
But im wife talk to am, “If di Lord wan kill us, e no go receive burnt offering and grain offering from our hand, e no go show us all dis things, and e no go tell us dis kind things for dis time.”
Di woman born pikin man, and name am Samson. Di pikin grow, and di Lord bless am.
Spirit of di Lord begin to move am for Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
Samson go down to Timnah, and see one woman for Timnah among di pikin woman dem of di Philistines.
E come up, and tell im papa and im mama, talk say, “I don see one woman for Timnah among di pikin woman dem of di Philistines. So now get am for me as my wife.”

Den im papa and im mama talk to am, “No woman dey among di pikin woman dem of your brothers, or among all my people, say you go take wife from di uncircumcised Philistines?” Samson talk to im papa, “Get am for me, because e please me well.”
But im papa and im mama no know say e come from di Lord, because e dey find chance against di Philistines. For dat time di Philistines dey rule over Israel.
Den Samson go down with im papa and mama to Timnah, and come reach di vineyards of Timnah. Look, one young lion roar at am.
Spirit of di Lord come on am with power, and e tear di lion as e go tear one young goat, and nothing dey im hand. But e no tell im papa or im mama wetin e do.
E go down, and talk with di woman, and e please Samson well.
After some time e return to take am, and e turn aside to see di carcass of di lion. Look, one swarm of bees dey di body of di lion, with honey.
E take am inside im hands, and go on, dey eat as e dey go. E come to im papa and mama, give dem, and dem eat. But e no tell dem say e take di honey from di body of di lion.
Im papa go down to di woman, and Samson make feast dere, because di young men dey do so.
E happen say, when dem see am, dem bring 30 friends to dey with am.
Samson talk to dem, “Make I tell una one riddle now. If una fit tell me di answer within di seven days of di feast, and find am out, den I go give una 30 linen garments and 30 changes of clothing.
But if una no fit tell me di answer, den una go give me 30 linen garments and 30 changes of clothing.” Dem talk to am, “Tell us your riddle, so that we go hear am.”
E talk to dem, “Out of di eater food come. Out of di strong sweetness come.” Dem no fit tell di riddle for three days.

E happen for di seventh day say dem talk to Samson wife, “Persuade your husband, so that e go tell us di riddle, otherwise we go burn you and your papa house with fire. Una call us here to make us poor? E no be so?”

Samson wife weep before am, and talk say, “You just hate me, and you no love me. You don put one riddle to di pikin dem of my people, and you no tell me di answer.” E talk to am, “Look, I no tell my papa or my mama, and I go tell you?”
E weep before am for di seven days wey dem feast dey go on. E happen for di seventh day say e tell am, because e press am hard. Den e tell di riddle to di pikin dem of im people.

Di men of di city talk to am for di seventh day before di sun go down, “Wetin sweet pass honey? Wetin strong pass lion?” E talk to dem, “If una no plough with my heifer, una no go find out my riddle.”

Spirit of di Lord come on am with power, and e go down to Ashkelon, strike 30 men of dem, take dem spoil, and give di changes of clothing to dem wey tell di riddle. Im anger burn, and e go up to im papa house.
But dem give Samson wife to im companion, wey be im friend.
But after some time, for di time of wheat harvest, Samson go visit im wife with one young goat. E talk say, “I go go in to my wife for di room.” But im papa no allow am to go in.
Di woman papa talk say, “I really think say you utterly hate am, so I give am to your companion. Im younger sister no fine pass am? Please make e be your own instead.”
Samson talk to dem, “Dis time I no go get blame concerning di Philistines, when I do dem harm.”
Samson go catch 300 foxes, take torches, turn tail to tail, and put one torch for di middle between every two tails.
When e don set di torches on fire, e let dem go enter di standing grain of di Philistines, and burn up di shocks and di standing grain, and di olive groves too.

Den di Philistines talk say, “Who do dis?” Dem talk say, “Samson, di husband of di Timnite pikin woman, because e don take im wife, and give am to im companion.” Di Philistines come up, and burn am and im papa with fire.
Samson talk to dem, “If una do like dis, surely I go take revenge on una, and after dat I go stop.”
E strike dem hip and thigh with great slaughter, and e go down dwell for di cleft of di rock of Etam.
Den di Philistines go up, camp for Judah, and spread demselves for Lehi.
Di men of Judah talk say, “Why una come up against us?” Dem talk say, “We come up to tie Samson, to do am as e do us.”
Den 3,000 men of Judah go to di top of di rock of Etam, and talk to Samson, “You no know say di Philistines dey rule over us? Wetin be dis wey you do us?” E talk to dem, “As dem do me, so I do dem.”
Dem talk to am, “We come down to tie you, so that we go deliver you into di hand of di Philistines.” Samson talk to dem, “Swear to me say una own self no go attack me.”
Dem speak to am, talk say, “No, but we go tie you well, and deliver you into dem hand. But surely we no go kill you.” Dem tie am with two new ropes, and bring am up from di rock.
When e reach Lehi, di Philistines shout as dem meet am. Spirit of di Lord come on am with power, and di ropes wey dey im arms become like flax wey fire burn, and im bands fall off im hands.
E find one fresh jawbone of donkey, stretch out im hand, take am, and strike one thousand men with am.
Samson talk say, “With di jawbone of donkey, heaps on heaps. With di jawbone of donkey I don strike one thousand men.”
E happen say, when e finish to speak, e throw di jawbone from im hand, and dem call dat place Ramath Lehi.
E dey very thirsty, and call on di Lord, talk say, “You don give dis great deliverance by di hand of your servant, and now I go die for thirst, and fall into di hands of di uncircumcised?”
But God split di hollow place wey dey Lehi, and water come out of am. When e drink, im spirit come back, and e revive. So dem call di name of am En Hakkore, wey dey Lehi till dis day.
E judge Israel for 20 years for di days of di Philistines.
Samson go Gaza, see one prostitute dere, and go in to am.

Dem tell di Gazites, “Samson don come here.” Dem surround am, and hide wait for am all night for di gate of di city, and dem dey quiet all di night, talk say, “Make we wait till morning light, den we go kill am.”

Samson lie down till midnight, and rise up for midnight, hold di doors of di gate of di city, and di two posts, pull dem up, bar and all, put dem on im shoulders, and carry dem go up to di top of di mountain wey dey before Hebron.
E happen say after dat, e love one woman for di valley of Sorek, wey im name na Delilah.

Di lords of di Philistines come up to am, and talk to am, “Persuade am, and see wia im great strength dey, and how we go fit win am, so that we go tie am to punish am. We go give you each 1,100 pieces of silver.”
Delilah talk to Samson, “Please tell me wia your great strength dey, and wetin dem fit use tie you to punish you.”
Samson talk to am, “If dem tie me with seven green cords wey never dry, den I go weak, and I go be like any other man.”
Den di lords of di Philistines bring seven green cords wey never dry up to am, and e tie am with dem.
Now men dey hide wait for di inner room. E talk to am, “Di Philistines dey on you, Samson!” E break di cords, as strand of tow dey break when e touch fire. So dem no know im strength.
Delilah talk to Samson, “Look, you don mock me, and tell me lies. Now please tell me wetin dem fit use tie you.”
E talk to am, “If dem tie me with new ropes wey dem never use do work, den I go weak, and I go be like any other man.”
So Delilah take new ropes, tie am with dem, and talk to am, “Di Philistines dey on you, Samson!” Di men dey hide wait for di inner room. E break dem off im arms like thread.
Delilah talk to Samson, “Till now you don mock me, and tell me lies. Tell me wetin dem fit use tie you.” E talk to am, “If you weave di seven locks of my head with di fabric for di loom.”
E fasten am with di pin, and talk to am, “Di Philistines dey on you, Samson!” E wake from im sleep, and pull away di pin of di beam, and di fabric.
E talk to am, “How you fit talk say, ‘I love you,’ when your heart no dey with me? You don mock me dis three times, and you no tell me wia your great strength dey.”
E happen say, as e dey press am every day with im words, and urge am, so tay im soul tire reach death,

e tell am all im heart, and talk to am, “Razor never touch my head, because I don dey Nazirite to God from my mama womb. If dem shave me, den my strength go leave me, and I go become weak, and be like any other man.”

When Delilah see say e don tell am all im heart, e send call di lords of di Philistines, talk say, “Come up dis once, because e don tell me all im heart.” Den di lords of di Philistines come up to am, and bring di money for dem hand.
Delilah make am sleep for im knees. E call one man, and e shave off di seven locks of im head. E begin to punish am, and im strength leave am.
E talk, “Di Philistines dey on you, Samson!” E wake from im sleep, and talk say, “I go go out as for other times, and shake myself free.” But e no know say di Lord don leave am.
Di Philistines catch am, and put out im eyes. Dem bring am down to Gaza, tie am with brass chains, and e dey grind for di mill for di prison.
But di hair of im head begin to grow again after dem don shave am.
Di lords of di Philistines gather demselves together to offer great sacrifice to Dagon dem god, and to rejoice, because dem talk say, “Our god don deliver Samson our enemy into our hand.”
When di people see am, dem praise dem god, because dem talk say, “Our god don deliver into our hand our enemy, di destroyer of our country, wey kill plenty of us.”
E happen say, when dem heart happy, dem talk say, “Call Samson, make e entertain us.” Dem call Samson from di prison, and e entertain dem. Dem put am between di pillars.
Samson talk to di boy wey hold am by di hand, “Allow me to feel di pillars wey di house dey rest on, so that I go lean on dem.”
Now di house full of men and women, and all di lords of di Philistines dey dere. For di roof about 3,000 men and women dey, wey dey look as Samson dey entertain.
Samson call to di Lord, and talk say, “Di Lord God, remember me, please, and strengthen me, please, only dis once, God, so that I go take revenge at once on di Philistines for my two eyes.”
Samson hold di two middle pillars wey di house dey rest on, and lean on dem, one with im right hand, and di other with im left.

Samson talk say, “Make I die with di Philistines.” E bow with all im strength, and di house fall on di lords, and on all di people wey dey inside am. So di dead wey e kill for im death pass di ones wey e kill for im life.
Den im brothers and all im papa house come down, take am, bring am up, and bury am between Zorah and Eshtaol for di burial place of Manoah im papa. E judge Israel for 20 years.
